text: Henning Jakob Henrik Lund or Intel'eraq (1875–1948) [1] was a Greenlandic lyricist, painter, and Lutheran pastor. title: Discover Greenland Music | Visit Greenland
text: The history of music in Greenland starts with traditional Inuit drum singing. Later, choir singing arrived via the German Moravian missionaries, polka via the European whalers, country music via the American soldiers during World War II, and Greenlandic-language protest rock in the 70s. The story ends today with modern musical styles.
